text:
Ava F (Finance): FYI partner CloudChannel Ltd flagged a $72,341 overage on the March Azure Marketplace settlement (invoice AZ-MP-2026-03-17). They say a SKU->meter mapping change we pushed on Mar 1 double-counted a subset of meters. Can someone triage? :eyes:

Liam B (Billing Ops): On it. Can you paste the invoice lines and the partner's example meter IDs?

Ava F (Finance): Partner sent these lines and a short CSV. Sample snippet below — looks like meter_id 98765 appears twice under different SKUs after the mapping change:
```
invoice_line_id,sku,meter_id,usage,charge
L-192837,sku-redwood-v1,98765,120000,21454.32
L-192838,sku-redwood-v1-alt,98765,120000,21454.32
L-192839,sku-redwood-emb,54321,40000,29432.36
```
Partner says total duplicate amount = $72,341.

Maya K (Sales): We updated the SKU mapping on Mar 1 to align with Azure SKU rename. I pinged ops but didn't get confirmation the mapping rollout reached channel/reseller path. Partner opened a ticket this morning. They want the duplicate portion credited and a one-cycle contract amendment to stop similar retro adjustments. :thinking_face:

Liam B (Billing Ops): If the partner's payout hasn't hit yet we can adjust before settlement. Do we have payout status? @BillingBot can you check AZ marketplace payout for CloudChannel Ltd?

BillingBot: Payout status for CloudChannel Ltd (partner_id: CC-9382): scheduled payout 2026-03-20 16:00 UTC, not yet processed. No holds currently.

Ava F (Finance): Good. We'll need approval for a manual credit and a short contract amendment. Proposed action: issue manual credit for $72,341 to partner account, record memo "AZ-MP-2026-03-CREDIT", and adjust the March settlement prior to payout. Also recommend a post-mortem to add a mapping rollout check.

Priya R (Head of Revenue): I approve a manual credit up to $75k pending legal sign-off on the amendment language. Please ensure we capture partner acceptance in writing.

Sofia (Legal): Draft amendment language below — I recommend this limited clause: "Partner consents to a one-time retroactive correction limited to the billing cycle ending 2026-03-17 for the identified SKU mapping error. This correction will not establish precedent for corrections earlier than 60 days prior to notice." If that works I'll send to the partner for e-sign. Also flag: ensure the partner accepts the dollar amount and waives further claims for the same issue.

Maya K (Sales): I'll send the draft and the credit confirmation to CloudChannel now and ask for signed acceptance EOD. I'll cc finance. Also proposing we add a launch checklist item: verify SKU mapping propagation across channel/reseller APIs.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Once we have signed acceptance, I'll run the adjustment and update GL. Proposed GL code for the credit: 4205-REV-CR. Journal entry: Debit Revenue (4205) / Credit Accounts Payable - Partner (2202) with memo "AZ-MP-2026-03-CREDIT".

Ava F (Finance): Confirm GL 4205-REV-CR. Proceed after partner signature. Also add a short note in the invoice record linking to the amendment. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

BillingBot: Noted. I'll place a temporary hold on the scheduled payout once finance marks the adjustment complete. Please notify me when the signed amendment is uploaded to the partner portal (link to doc expected).

Maya K (Sales): Uploaded amendment and partner signed at 2026-03-20 09:42 UTC — sending confirmation email now.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Running adjustment now. Posting journal and reducing payout amount by $72,341. Memo AZ-MP-2026-03-CREDIT added. Will follow up in accounting once posted.

Ava F (Finance): Received. Marking as resolved in the billing queue. Let's schedule a brief post-mortem with EngOps and Sales to avoid reoccurrence.

Sofia (Legal): Closing note — amendment retained in contract repository. All good from legal side.

BillingBot: Payout updated. New scheduled payout amount for CloudChannel Ltd reflects credit. No further action pending.

Maya K (Sales): Thanks team, closing the loop with CloudChannel.
